protocol: Three public tracks, three ABBA blocks per track per comparison. Nine processes, 108 samples. Separate cold first samples for each native backend/authentication mode in each process. Python always starts a fresh helper, so all Python samples remain in the operational baseline. Signed URLs and credentials excluded.

reports.name: anonymous-backends-Az4SnX521pI
reports.note: Strict native calls, no fallback. Retained clients; first samples include cold initialization. Fresh mpv per sample with null audio output. start_ms measures resolve to first positive mpv position, not audible hardware output. Authentication comparisons can return different quality; group results by codec/format.
